{{Quote|These machines are extermination droids&mdash;my infinite army|Revan deploying droids to defend the Foundry|<ref name="TOR:TF">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Foundry}}</ref>}}
'''Extermination droids''' were a class of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] constructed at the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] installation known as [[Foundry (space station)|The Foundry]]. These machines came in a variety of classes from bipedal units to quad legged ones with some ranging from [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] height to others being much larger. They were equipped with [[Bioscan/Legends|bioscanners]] that were able to detect the genetic material of their targets which allowed the droids to focus on specific species.

They were commissioned during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] after [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was freed from his imprisonment by forces from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Upon being released, Revan was determined to stop the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] at all costs and traveled to the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] facility where he began using the installation to manufacture an endless army with which he intended to exterminate anyone with [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] bloodlines. This act would have led to the elimination of 97.8% of the population of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Coordination and command of these units was left in the hands of the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]].

At the time, a strike force was dispatched into the Foundry in order to stop Revan where the spacers encountered the extermination droids that were defending the installation. After the Foundry was captured by the Empire, [[Darth Malgus]] would commandeer its resources, including a rebuilt and reprogrammed HK-47, during his brief rule over a "[[New Empire]]." The army at his disposal included rewired extermination droids.

==Behind the scenes==
These droids feature as antagonists during the ''"A Call to Arms"'' quest chain.
